mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ecom_logistics_rate (channel_id, country, min_weight, max_weight, base_fee, per_kg, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.channelId}, #{i.country}, #{i.minWeight}, #{i.maxWeight}, #{i.baseFee}, #{i.perKg}, #{i.remark}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.code AS channel_code, c.name AS channel_name, c.provider, c.transport_mode, c.days_min, c.days_max FROM ecom_logistics_rate r JOIN ecom_logistics_channel c ON c.id = r.channel_id WHERE c.status = 1 AND (r.country = #{country} OR r.country = '*') AND r.min_weight <= #{weight} AND (r.max_weight IS NULL OR r.max_weight > #{weight}) ORDER BY c.id, r.country DESC
